financial_capacity_tests.stage: Before migration280; financial subset superseded by postgres-projection-isolation-summary.json

design_bounds: No stored billing command is executed by compensation/recheck. Monetary transactions maintain only fixed-size source-row numeric projections and a revision; no observer-table I/O occurs in that trigger. Background ledger entries describe aggregate revision ranges, not individual monetary events.
Persistent gap acknowledgement requires administrator identity and explanation; cumulative missed_count is never cleared, and new gaps make health Unknown again.
Operational totals become Unknown if the audit is stale, incomplete, lacks account ledger coverage, or any pod has unpersisted observation gaps.
Financial compensation_backlog counts settlement observation outbox queued/manual_required entries; it does not claim to count pre-billing media generation/polling business jobs.

Normal soft deletion preserves account projections. Physically deleted accounts previously observed by the reconciler become missing-source/Unknown findings; a source created and physically deleted entirely between observations has no complete per-event audit guarantee.
deployment_risks: Migrations279/280 seed and transfer opening balances/projections under table locks and update source rows. Schedule upgrade for real account volume; historical account events are not reconstructed.

Each monetary update performs bounded fixed numeric/revision work in its own source row. Observer table slowness/locks cannot block it; backend tests and independent review proved Go/server100ms monetary commits while observer INSERT sleeps400ms or observer tables hold ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks. Local sequential timing is not production load acceptance.

Observer writes use the business pool with two bounded independent deadlines. Nominal added wait is <=100ms default or <=400ms configured cap; actual driver cancellation/connection establishment has scheduling overhead.
A process crash before gap flush can lose an unpersisted interval; export process counters and structured failure logs to independent monitoring. Root added Prometheus missing-observation rules.

Real isolated Redis8.4 three-master validation passed hotspot82/100 versus1/1000 and1/1000, failed-nodeUnknown, and per-instance poolbudget12/actual3. This is functional coverage, not a capacity stress benchmark.
